name: Ag Processing Solutions, Inc.
old_description: Ag Processing Solutions is a team of engineers and fabricators specializing in the design and construction of agricultural processing facilities tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. In addition to our design and consulting services, we operate an 11,000 sq. ft. processing facility where we offer toll cleaning, milling and pelleting for nearly any commodity under the sun. We also specialize in the fabrication and design of custom stainless steel belt conveyors for your agricultural processing facility. Whether you're looking to build a new agricultural processing plant, need help with optimizing your current facility or need custom-engineered solutions, our team has the expertise and resources to assist in your journey.
about:
Ag Processing Solutions, Inc. is based in Great Falls, Montana. The company was founded by Andrew (as indicated by the contact email ), though the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business began as a team of engineers and fabricators focused on agricultural processing facility design and construction.

The company designs and constructs agricultural processing facilities and operates an 11,000-square-foot processing plant where it provides toll cleaning, milling, and pelleting for a wide range of commodities. It also fabricates custom stainless-steel belt conveyors and offers facility design, equipment sourcing, and optimization services. The Great Falls facility recently added 12 high-paying jobs, though total headcount is not disclosed.

Ag Processing Solutions serves agricultural producers and processors, with documented work in hemp, pulse, and plant-based protein supply chains. Montana Ag Network coverage highlights the company's role in industrial hemp processing and efforts to build a regional supply chain for plant-based proteins. Customers include growers and processors seeking facility construction, toll processing, or custom conveying equipment.

The firm emphasizes tailored, end-to-end solutions — from initial facility design through custom equipment fabrication and ongoing toll processing — positioning itself as a single-source partner for agricultural processing projects.
